remarks: Tucked into a quiet corner of East Amherst, this first-floor condominium offers easy, low-maintenance living in a most desirable WNY community. Two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and 966 square feet come together in a layout that works well whether you're settling into your first condominium, downsizing, or just looking for a low-upkeep place to call home. Step inside and you're greeted by an abundance of natural light pouring in through the french doors complementing the luxury vinyl floors adding warmth and character to the living space. Easy and few stairs to navigate makes for comfortable, single-story living — everything you need on one level. The owner's bedroom is generously sized, easily fitting a king bed, and includes a walk-in closet. The basement gives you flexible space for laundry, storage, or the potential to create an additional living area down the road. Outside, the classic brick exterior façade gives the building lasting curb appeal, and the rear deck is a nice spot to enjoy your morning coffee, unwind after work and enjoy our beautiful 4 seasons. The assigned parking space means you'll always have a spot waiting for you.Access to Ransom Oaks amenities, pool, tennis & pickle ball courts, are available for an additional annual fee if desired. Garage optional when available. The 2nd bedroom doors are in the basement.
